text:
Priya S.: quick one 
Help! had a client demo and my living room turned into "Vacuum Rave". Trying to jury-rig a noise shield between meetings. anyone tried rugs + lamp placements? :grimacing:
Marc: rugs help for high freq. put a thick throw rug behind you and a tall coat or blanket on a chair to break reflections. angle a floor lamp so its not pointing at mic (reflections!).
Olga: move the mic off the desk onto a stack of soft books. that stops the desk-thump. also enable app-level noise suppression.
Priya S.: thanks, doing book trick. also my upload tanked mid-demo: ```
Ping 42 ms
DL 10.2 Mbps
UL 0.5 Mbps
```
IT-Ben: 0.5 upl is the killer. if you're on ISP gateway, try bridging it and plug a travel router with QoS in front. otherwise tether phone to 5G for critical calls. powerline adapters can help if ethernet isn't in reach.
Marc: also worth checking if roommate started some cloud backup during your call. background uploads can murder uplink.
Priya S.: lol roommate insists their cloud "is updating my entire life." will negotiate backup schedule.
status-bot: Provider outage notice for your area earlier today (Ticket #NET-2026-339). ETA restore: 1935685000.
Olga: honest enforcement: if you post fort pics you must include a dramatic vacuum-face. community law. :camera_with_flash:
Priya S.: fair. assembling rug-baffle now. will post before/after pics and a vacuum face for science. thanks all for tips and the QoS primer, Ben.
IT-Ben: happy to lend a travel router if needed 
DM me.
Marc: also PSA: if you use phone tether as fallback, enable hotspot password and keep battery charger handy. Meetings + hotspot = battery drain.
Priya S.: will do. Fort construction commencing in 3...2... :construction:
Olga: good luck. if the vacuum starts harmonizing, lean into it - call it ambience.
